seo.title: Derbyshire Wedding Photographer & Videographer | Zen Visuals
seo.description: Rated 5.0 from 22 Google reviews. Wedding photography and film by Zuzia and Ben in Belper, Derbyshire. Your whole day from £750. Check your date.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.text: Wedding photography and film across Derbyshire and beyond, from getting ready to the last dance. Natural, unposed, and true to how your day felt. One price covers the whole day, and your photos and film arrive within 3–6 weeks.
weddings.image_alt: Bride and groom facing each other under a green bandstand
weddings.venues: Venues include Shottle Hall, West Mill in Darley Abbey, and weddings in London.

commercial.title: Commercial
commercial.text: Adverts, promotional films, product photography and corporate events for businesses in Derbyshire and across the UK, crafted around what you need people to feel and do. Ben has also worked behind the scenes on shoots for well-known brands in automotive and aerospace engineering.
commercial.image_alt: Workshop light reflected along the curve of a classic car

about.title: We are Zuzia
about.image_alt: Zuzia and Ben in black, leaning on a dry stone wall under bare oak trees in Derbyshire
paragraphs: Our story began when we met a few years back. Over time we became friends, and through the ups and downs our relationship grew stronger. In March 2023 we promised to love and support one another, and got married.
Ben has been working as a photographer and videographer since 2014, and Zuzia joined him behind the camera in 2023.
Photography and film helped us make new connections and grow, as people and as a couple. Now our goal is simple: to help others capture their stories and keep their most precious memories forever.

reviews.featured_quote: The trust you give to those capturing the biggest day of your life is a big responsibility, but I honestly could not recommend them enough.

pricing.intro: One price for your whole wedding day. No hourly packages and no watching the clock: we stay for as long as you need us.

packages.name: Photography
packages.description: Your whole day in photographs, from getting ready to the dance floor.

packages.name: Photo + Film
packages.description: Photographs of the whole day plus a 3–6 minute wedding film, with every angle covered.

packages.name: Film
packages.description: Your whole day on film, cut into a 3–6 minute wedding film to watch again and again.

pricing.commercial_text: Every brief is different, so we quote per project. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll come back with a price.

extras.name: Ceremony & speeches
extras.description: Your full ceremony and every speech, filmed start to finish and edited as their own films, alongside your wedding film.

contact.title: Let's make something
contact.area: Based in Belper, Derbyshire, working across the UK
contact.thank_you: Thank you! We've got your message and will be in touch soon.
contact.areas: Covering Belper, Derby, Matlock, Ashbourne, the Peak District and the rest of the UK.

steps.title: Tell us your date
steps.text: Send us your date and venue through the form below, by email or by phone, and we'll check we're free.

steps.title: Secure your date
steps.text: Half of the price secures your date. Once it's paid, the day is yours.

steps.title: Your wedding day
steps.text: We stay for the whole day, from getting ready to the last dance, and capture it as it happens.

steps.title: Your photos and film
steps.text: Everything is ready within 3 to 6 weeks. The rest of the balance is due any time up to two weeks after the wedding.

editing.title: Hours in the edit for every minute
editing.text: Filming is only half of it. Every minute of finished film takes hours at the desk in DaVinci Resolve: choosing the moments, shaping the story, grading the colour and mixing the sound until it feels like your day.
editing.note: Frames and soundtrack from Robyn and Gabriel's wedding film.

steps.title: The cut
steps.text: We go through everything we filmed, keep the moments that matter and build them into the story of your day.

steps.title: The colour
steps.text: Every shot is graded by hand, so skin tones look natural and the whole film sits together whatever the light was doing.

steps.title: The sound
steps.text: Vows, speeches and music are cleaned up and mixed, so you hear every word.

sound.title: Sound you'd only notice if it was gone
sound.text: At the bigger moments we add subtle sound design: small effects layered under the music and the real audio. You'll hardly notice them while you watch, but you'd miss them if they weren't there.
